name: Almadén (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a white triangle issuing from the hoist to the fly, charged with the crowned municipal arms of Almadén (a castle, a lion and mining tools).
history: Municipal flag of Almadén; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle from the hoist edge to the fly
